title: Efforts to Ensure Work Pass Holders are Aware of COVID-19 Measures
what_it_is: Efforts to Ensure Work Pass Holders are Aware of COVID-19 Measures

sections.label: MOM approval for work pass entry
sections.summary: Since 9 February 2020, employers must get MOM's prior approval before affected work pass holders can enter Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As part of our control measures, since 9 February 2020, employers have to obtain MOM's prior approval before the affected work pass holders can enter Singapore.

sections.label: Action against employers breaching requirements
sections.summary: As of 22 February 2020, MOM acted against 15 employers whose workers breached Leave of Absence or Stay-Home Notice requirements, suspending work pass privileges for at least two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As of 22 February 2020, MOM has taken action against 15 employers whose workers breached the Leave of Absence or Stay-Home Notice requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These employers had their work pass privileges suspended for at least two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In three instances, the workers were not found culpable and were provided the opportunity to find alternative employment in Singapore.

sections.label: Five-day MC for respiratory symptoms
sections.summary: The five-day MC is given to individuals with respiratory symptoms to rest at home and prevent COVID-19 spread.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The five-day MC is granted to individuals who display respiratory symptoms to allow them to rest at home and prevent the spread of COVID-19.

sections.label: Government grant to employers
sections.summary: For Leave of Absence, Stay-Home Notice or quarantine, the Government provides the employer a grant of $100 a day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: With the Leave of Absence, Stay-Home Notice or quarantine, the Government does provide a grant to the employer of $100 a day.

sections.label: Responsibility for return approval
sections.summary: Responsibility for approval to return is both the worker's and the employer's, and workers were not punished when they reported being forced to return.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In the case where the two workers came back to Singapore without approval, can I just ask what is the rationale of punishing the workers when it was not them who had to apply to get the approval to return?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: It is both the responsibility of the worker and the employer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: There are cases in which we have not punished the worker because the worker came to report to us and said his employer had forced him to come back.
